gbm_population_evidence.quote: Diagnosed with glioblastoma through histopathological examination;

candidate_evidence.quote: Inject WL276 CAR-T cells through local intracranial administration using the Ommaya device, once a week for 3 weeks.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Patients with unresectable recurrent or progressive glioblastoma who have failed or are intolerant to standard treatment;

role_evidence.quote: WL276 CAR-T Cell Therapy for CD276 Positive Recurrent or Progressive Glioblastoma Patients

arms: CD276 positive recurrent or progressive glioblastoma

source_quote.quote: have positive CD276 expression detected by immunohistochemistry

flag.reason: CD276 is the CAR-T target, but the CAR-T product is an excluded intervention type and not a candidate, so coded candidate_matched false.

coder_notes: EARLY_PHASE1 (translational subset). Only intervention is a CAR-T cell therapy (excluded type), so no candidate. CD276 positivity is an entry requirement and matches the CAR-T target, but because the product is not a candidate it is coded false; adjudicator to confirm. Other outcomes include CAR-T persistence in blood, CSF and/or tumour tissue and cytokine changes; not coded as tumour PK or target engagement because no candidate agent exists.
